Container.Name: particull
Container.Overview: A simple parts inventory for makers. Keep track of the components you have, import a project's bill of materials, and see what's in stock, what needs a quick check, and what to buy. Exports your inventory as chat context so project builds can use parts you already own.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The parts database (particull.db). Back up this folder.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Leave empty for open access on your LAN. Set one to require sign-in, for example when it's reachable through your reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: true when served through Nginx Proxy Manager or another proxy, so sign-in cookies are marked secure and login limits see real client addresses.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for dates in exports and backups.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the database file.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the database file.
